verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a SaaS telephony service, so the axis applies. The pack contains no Google Voice API reference and nothing about runnable examples or an API explorer. The only API-reference item is the generic Workspace Admin Reports activities endpoint, which is a different product surface, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
